entities.name: Aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase-like query
observations: 341-aa query sequence; strong homology support for aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase (EC 1.2.1.11), with 53.6–55.8% identity and 98.2% query coverage to reviewed bacterial homologs.
Pfam matches Semialdhyde_dh (PF01118.31; residues 8–120) and Semialdhyde_dhC (PF02774.24; residues 142–319).

Homolog annotations describe NADPH-dependent reductive dephosphorylation of L-aspartyl-4-phosphate to L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde; homologs are homodimers involved in lysine, methionine, and threonine biosynthesis. Query-specific reaction and oligomeric state are inferred from homology, not experimentally demonstrated.
